He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]]. He was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] as a sophomore with Colorado. ==High school career== Walker played basketball for [[Campbell Hall School]] in [[Los Angeles|Los Angeles, California]] for three years.{{cite web |last1=Rosenberg |first1=Gregg |title=Rosenberg Q&A: Past and Present with Jabari Walker |url=https://arizonavarsity.rivals.com/news/rosenberg-q-a-past-and-present-with-jabari-walker |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=May 3, 2020}} For his senior season, he transferred to AZ Compass Prep in [[Chandler, Arizona]].{{cite web |last1=Chalifoux |first1=Adam |title=Tale of the Tape: Jabari Walker |url=https://www.si.com/college/colorado/basketball/tale-of-tape-jabari-walker |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=April 7, 2020}} As a senior, he averaged 13 points, 8 rebounds, and 1.5 blocks per game. Walker competed for Dream Vision on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] circuit.{{cite web |last1=Guerrerio |first1=Justin |title=Dream Vision AAU coach Clayton Williams breaks down CU target Jabari Walker |url=https://colorado.rivals.com/news/dream-vision-aau-coach-clayton-williams-breaks-down-cu-target-jabari-walker |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=March 24, 2020}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] over offers from [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]] and [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Saint Mary's]].{{cite web |last1=Rooney |first1=Pat |title=CU Buffs basketball adds 2020 forward Jabari Walker |url=https://www.denverpost.com/2020/04/08/cu-basketball-adds-2020-forward-jabari-walker/ |website=[[The Denver Post]] |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=April 8, 2020}} ==College career== On January 14, 2021, Walker recorded 23 points and 11 rebounds in an 89–60 win over [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]].{{cite web |last1=Rooney |first1=Pat |title=CU men’s basketball notes: Freshman Jabari Walker growing up in a hurry for Buffs |url=https://www.buffzone.com/2021/01/14/cu-mens-basketball-notes-freshman-jabari-walker-growing-up-in-a-hurry-for-buffs/ |website=BuffZone |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=January 24, 2021}} In February, he missed six games with a foot injury.{{cite web |last1=Rooney |first1=Pat |title=Jabari Walker embracing prep for bigger role with CU Buffs men’s basketball |url=https://www.buffzone.com/2021/04/23/jabari-walker-embracing-prep-for-bigger-role-with-cu-buffs-mens-basketball/ |website=BuffZone |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=April 23, 2021}} On March 20, 2021, Walker scored a freshman season-high 24 points, shooting 5-of-5 from three-point range, in a 96–73 victory over [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]] at the first round of the [[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|NCAA Tournament]].{{cite web |last1=Shapiro |first1=Jake |title=Jabari Walker goes ballistic as Buffaloes beat Hoyas, advance in NCAA Tournament |url=https://247sports.com/college/colorado/Article/Colorado-Buffaloes-basketball-NCAA-Tournament-win-over-Georgetown-Hoyas-2021-162751904/ |website=[[247Sports]] |access-date=May 26, 2021 |date=March 20, 2021}} As a freshman, he averaged 7.6 points and 4.3 rebounds per game, earning [[Pac-12 Conference|Pac-12]] All-Freshman Team honors. On January 25, 2022, Walker tied a career-high 24 points in a 82–78 win over [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]].{{cite news |title=Colorado completes comeback in 82-78 win over Oregon |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401408541 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=May 3, 2022 |date=January 25, 2022}} As a sophomore, he averaged 14.6 points and 9.4 rebounds per game and was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]].{{cite press release|url=https://pac-12.com/article/2022/03/08/2021-22-pac-12-mens-basketball-all-conference-honors-and-annual-performance|title=2021-22 Pac-12 Men's Basketball All-Conference honors and Annual Performance Awards, presented by Nextiva|publisher=[[Pac-12 Conference]] |date=March 8, 2022 |accessdate=March 8, 2022}} On March 30, 2022, Walker declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web |last1=Ritenour |first1=Zach |title=Jabari Walker announces he will declare for the 2022 NBA Draft |url=https://coloradobuffaloeswire.usatoday.com/2022/03/30/jabari-walker-announces-declare-2022-nba-draft/ |website=[[USA Today]] |access-date=April 16, 2022 |date=March 30, 2022}} He later signed with an [[sports agent|agent]], forgoing his remaining eligibility.{{cite web |last=Rooney |first=Pat |title=Done deal: Jabari Walker reportedly ‘all in’ for NBA draft |url=https://www.buffzone.com/2022/05/02/done-deal-jabari-walker-reportedly-all-in-for-nba-draft/amp/ |website=BuffZone |access-date=May 3, 2022 |date=May 2, 2022}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player
